title: NSIC Rc 450H (Mestiso 75) Rice Variety: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: NSIC Rc 450H is a hybrid rice for irrigated lowland: about 110 days and 6.4 tonnes per hectare on average. See its pest ratings and grain quality.
excerpt: NSIC Rc 450H is a hybrid rice variety for irrigated lowland, known locally as Mestiso 75. The NSIC approved it in 2016. Syngenta bred it. It matures in about 110 days and averages 6.4 tonnes per hectare, with a top yield of 13 tonnes in trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for rice variety 450H, or Rc 450H, this is the one. The facts below come from PhilRice's catalogue of released varieties, its Binhing Palay app, and its public seed database. So you can compare it with the other varieties in our [rice variety finder](/rice-varieties) before you buy seed. Also read our guide to [rice varieties in the Philippines](/crops/rice-varieties-philippines) for how inbreds, hybrids and special rice differ.

items: **Yield:** 6.4 tonnes per hectare on average, or about 128 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 13 tonnes.
**Watch out for:** bacterial leaf blight, tungro, sheath blight.
**Cooked rice:** high amylose, so firm and fluffy.

blocks.text: How much does NSIC Rc 450H yield?

On average it gives 6.4 tonnes per hectare. That is about 128 cavans of 50 kilograms of palay. It sits close to the average of the 110 irrigated lowland hybrids in PhilRice's list, which is 6.3 tonnes. But the top yield, 13 tonnes, came from a trial with good water, seed and care. So plan your costs on the average, then work toward the top with the habits in our guide to [raising rice yield per hectare](/blog/increase-rice-yield-per-hectare).
How many days does it take to mature?

It takes about 110 days from sowing to harvest. IRRI groups varieties of 100 to 120 days as short duration and 120 to 140 days as medium, so this one counts as short duration. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains turn golden yellow, as PalayCheck advises. Because the day count drives every task, anee.io counts it for you from each lot's own planting day, with the [growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: So scout early for [bacterial leaf blight](/diseases/bacterial-leaf-blight), [tungro](/diseases/rice-tungro), [sheath blight](/diseases/sheath-blight). When you see the first signs, check the guide before you spray, because the right timing saves more than an extra dose. If you are not sure what you see, our [pest and disease finders](/features/pest-and-disease-finders) help you name it from the damage.

blocks.caption: Grain quality in PhilRice's seed database

blocks.text: Amylose decides how rice cooks. With high amylose, expect rice that is firm and dry, and it hardens as it cools. In fact, PhilRice notes that Filipino taste moved from high to intermediate and low amylose rice, because people want it softer. Head rice is the share of whole grains after milling. So a higher number means fewer broken grains and a better price at the mill.

It suits irrigated lowland, where you control the water. Level the field well so the water stands evenly, and plant at the same time as your neighbors, one of the PalayCheck key checks, so pests cannot move from field to field. Our guide to [rice land preparation](/land-preparation/rice-land-preparation) shows each step. PhilRice recommends it for the dry season. You can plant it dry direct seeded, transplanted or wet direct seeded. For the right month in your province, see [the best time to plant rice](/blog/best-time-to-plant-rice-philippines).

items.q: What is the local name of NSIC Rc 450H?
items.a: It is known as Mestiso 75. Seed sellers and agriculturists use both names, so ask for either one.

items.q: How many days does NSIC Rc 450H take to harvest?
items.a: About 110 days after sowing. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains are golden yellow.

items.q: What is the average yield of NSIC Rc 450H?
items.a: PhilRice lists 6.4 tonnes per hectare on average, about 128 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 13 tonnes. Your own yield depends on water, seed, fertilizer and timing.

items.q: In which season should I plant it?
items.a: PhilRice recommends it for the dry season. Then pick the month with our planting calendar guide and the forecast for your town.
Yes. So buy new seed each season, because seed saved from a hybrid crop does not grow true and yields less.

items.q: What should I watch for when I plant it?
items.a: In PhilRice's tests it was weak against bacterial leaf blight, tungro, sheath blight. So scout from the early weeks and act at the first signs.
